lines.text: Here are twelve pink dots. We want a line that predicts where new dots will fall.
A wiggly line can pass through every pink dot. Zero error.
Now add blue dots the model never saw. The wiggly line misses them badly.
It did not learn the pattern. It memorized the noise.
A simpler line misses some pink dots. But it lands close to the blue ones.
As a model gets more complex, error on the pink dots keeps falling. Error on the blue dots falls, then rises.
That gap is overfitting. So judge a model only on data it has not seen.
